blurb: Con Todo Dance Company offers a variety of dance and fitness classes designed for busy individuals and executives. Classes include Salsa, Bachata, Cumbia, stretching and conditioning, and private one-on-one lessons tailored to personal goals. Classes are open-level and focus on fitness, rhythm, and confidence building.
